input.final_result:
**Answer: $84,002 thousand (about $84.0 million), or roughly 50.72% of total undiscounted operating lease payments.**

**Source data:** MSCI's FY2024 10-K (filed February 7, 2025), Note 7 (Leases), "Maturities of the Company's operating lease liabilities... as of December 31, 2024." As of April 7, 2025, this is the most recent annual filing available. Figures are in thousands:

| Year | Operating leases |
|---|---|
| 2025 | $30,220 |
| 2026 | 30,361 |
| 2027 | 24,421 |
| 2028 | 23,931 |
| 2029 | 16,573 |
| Thereafter | 40,099 |
| Total lease payments (undiscounted) | $165,605 |
| Less: interest | (19,601) |
| Present value of lease liabilities | $146,004 |

**Calculation:**
- Next three years (2025–2027): 30,220 + 30,361 + 24,421 = **$84,002 thousand**
- Percentage of total undiscounted payments: 84,002 / 165,605 = **50.72%**

**Data caveat:** The individual year rows sum to $164,605 thousand (2025–Thereafter), not the $165,605 total printed in the filing. The stated total is consistent with the $19,601 interest deduction and the $146,004 present value, so I used the printed total. If the denominator is instead the sum of the rows, the share is 84,002 / 164,605 = 51.03%. The three-year dollar amount ($84,002 thousand) is unaffected either way.

**Sources:**

            "name": "MSCI Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (Note 7 - Leases)"
        }
    ]
}
